name: Praia Padel Club Indoor
description: Praia Padel Club Indoor is Cabo Verde’s flagship indoor padel stop on Avenida Cidade de Lisboa in Várzea, Praia. Bookable courts with racket hire, changing rooms and a shop — the clear recommendation when you want dedicated padel in the capital rather than a resort corner. Host of the Praia Padel Cup; reserve ahead for evening sessions.
